verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers client-facing digital tools, including the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon apps, so data-residency choice is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions selectable storage regions or residency controls. Its global office hubs and privacy legal practice describe legal services, not a product feature for choosing where user data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
